'''Harte Secur Airbase''' was a military installation used by the [[Naboo Airforce]], located southwest of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Harte Secur]]. It harbored some of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] best [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] from the Airbase attacked the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] forces under [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].

==Description==
Harte Secur Airbase was located southwest of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Harte Secur]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It contained several buildings on two sides of a paved stone path that ran through its center, which came to a dead end marked by an obelisk in front of a cliff on the northwest side. The southwestern facing side of the Airbase had two [[prefab shelter]]s, a [[command center]], a [[Power core/Legends|power core]], and a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], while the northeastern side had two [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]]s with a power core between them, and another two prefab shelters. The buildings in Harte Secur Airbase were decorated with [[Color/Legends|orange]] patterns. The Airbase was utilized by the [[Naboo Airforce]] and as such was capable of deploying aircraft. [[Royal trade ship]]s transported goods between Harte Secur and the Airbase.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
[[File:OOM9SortOfCommanding-TPM.jpg|thumb|right|200px|OOM-9 was given a reconnaissance report about the pilots from Harte Secur Airbase.]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the Airbase was guarded by one [[Udopal speeder]] rider. As the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] prepared to [[Capture of Harte Secur|attack]] Harte Secur, their information networks uncovered that the Airbase harbored some of Naboo's best [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], and a briefing to the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] recommended that he destroy the Airbase after retrieving a [[droid control program]] that the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] had stolen.<ref name="GB" /> Once OOM-9 regained the program, [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]]<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> from the Airbase attacked his [[Deactivated Camp|camp]].<ref name="GB" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
OOM-9's forces later destroyed the Airbase.<ref name="GB" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Harte Secur Airbase appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', in which it is featured in the second level of the Trade Federation campaign: "Behind the Lines." Destroying the Airbase is optional for the player but recommended by the level's reconnaissance report. If the player does not quickly destroy Harte Secur Airbase, it spawns [[N-1L Light Starfighter]]s and [[NB-1 Royal Bomber]]s to attack their camp.<ref name="GB" />
